description: Public UX features: course browse page, paper ratings, request-a-paper form, client-side result filter, year range filter, download history, WhatsApp share improvement, bookmarks, and full-screen PDF viewer. All operate on the existing schema plus migration 004 (ratings). Independent from FEAT-003 and FEAT-004. Depends on FEAT-001 (ToastProvider in layout, packages installed).
steps: Create supabase/migrations/004_ratings.sql with exact SQL: CREATE TABLE public.paper_ratings (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), paper_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.papers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, session_id text NOT NULL, rating int NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE(paper_id, session_id)); ALTER TABLE public.paper_ratings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY "Anyone can rate" ON public.paper_ratings FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (true); CREATE POLICY "Anyone can read ratings" ON public.paper_ratings FOR SELECT USING (true); CREATE POLICY "Users can update own rating" ON public.paper_ratings FOR UPDATE USING (true);

Edit src/types/database.ts: add PaperRatingsRow = { id:string; paper_id:string; session_id:string; rating:number; created_at:string }, PaperRatingsInsert = { id?:string; paper_id:string; session_id:string; rating:number; created_at?:string }, PaperRatingsUpdate = { rating?:number }. Add paper_ratings table to Database.public.Tables with Row/Insert/Update.

Create src/app/api/papers/[id]/rate/route.ts: POST handler. Parse body as { rating: number, sessionId: string }. Validate with zod: z.object({ rating: z.number().int().min(1).max(5), sessionId: z.string().min(1) }). Use createAdminClient(). Upsert into paper_ratings: .from('paper_ratings').upsert({ paper_id: params.id, session_id: sessionId, rating }, { onConflict: 'paper_id,session_id' }). Then query average: .from('paper_ratings').select('rating').eq('paper_id', params.id). Compute avg and count, return { averageRating, ratingCount }. Return 400 for validation errors.

Create src/components/StarRating.tsx: 'use client'. Props: { paperId:string; initialAverage:number; initialCount:number }. On mount, read/create localStorage key pq:sessionId (crypto.randomUUID() if absent). State: userRating (number|null) read from localStorage pq:rating:{paperId}, currentAvg, currentCount. Render 5 star buttons (aria-label='Rate N stars', aria-pressed). On click: POST /api/papers/{paperId}/rate, update state. Show '{avg.toFixed(1)} ★ ({count} ratings)' below stars. No dark: classes.

Compute averageRating and ratingCount. (b) Add `<StarRating paperId={paper.id} initialAverage={averageRating} initialCount={ratingCount} />` as a dynamic import (ssr:false) after the meta grid. (c) Update the WhatsApp href text to: `Check out this TTU past question: ${paper.title} — ${siteUrl}/papers/${paper.id}` (the em dash is fine inside encodeURIComponent). (d) Add 'Full screen' link button below the preview iframe/img: `<Link href={'/view/'+paper.id} className='mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-brand-primary hover:underline'><svg aria-hidden width='16' height='16' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' strokeWidth='2'><path d='M8 3H5a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v3m18 0V5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2h-3m0 18h3a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-3M3 16v3a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h3'/></svg> Full screen</Link>`
